_doc: Scrubbed real CLI streams (issue #32), each captured with the adapter's own invocation() (the production recipe) in a scratch repo, scrubbed with scrub.py and reviewed by hand. Replay only checks that today's parser handles these streams; the recipe is recorded per entry. Refresh when a CLI bump or adapter contract change is accepted, or when fixing drift.
